text_block_list.text:
Team <First> began conducting independent 
training in secret from Acting Principal 
Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, the atmosphere around the Team <First> 
girls feels like it has changed, YES!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday in the dorm cafeteria, I saw 
everyone eating together while having some 
super complicated talk!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's usually eating by themselves, 
so that totally surprised me!

Then, one day, on the way back from 
training with Taiki Shuttle――

We happened upon a scene where members of 
Team <First> were being scolded.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Did you really think I wouldn't 
notice...! You certainly underestimated 
me."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: No! We were just...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Because in the practice match, compared 
to my opponent, I hadn't grown at all...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: There is no need to worry about that!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Still, you carefully put together a 
personalized program for every single one 
of us...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We're the ones who are falling short. 
That's why we need to grow on our own even 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Why are you worrying about such 
unnecessary things?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Just run the way I tell you to! I'm 
saying this for your own good!"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I got a bit too emotional. We will 
dismiss for today.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: “...... Sorry. It's my fault.”

Team First fell into a gloomy silence. 
Just as I held my breath, wondering what 
to do—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, what!? That doesn't make any sense!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
None of you are in the wrong! Wanting to 
grow is only natural!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Acting Principal Kashimoto does not care 
about her teammates, yes...!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto really thinks about us. 
She genuinely cares for us."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Both the dietary management and the 
training regimen were designed with only 
our bodies in mind.

In apparent agreement, the surrounding 
team members nodded in unison.

For someone who claims to be purely 
devoted, her methods are quite forceful. 
She has no intention of accepting any 
other approach whatsoever.

"Besides, Chairwoman Akikawa has just been 
watching Acting Director Kashimoto. Come 
to think of it, there are a lot of strange 
things going on."

Just then, I suddenly recalled the words 
Tazuna-san had told me before.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman knows this academy inside 
and out, so she might be seeing things 
from a different perspective..."

Chairwoman Akikawa might know something. 
Together with my team members and Team <First>, I 
headed to where Chairwoman Akikawa was.
That made things quick.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, acknowledged! You all have every 
right to hear this!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain! Exactly why! Why she 
overmanages her Umamusume! The very reason 
for it!

According to Chairwoman Akikawa, Acting 
Director Kashimoto used to be a trainer 
who respected an Umamusume's freedom.

She built a strong bond of trust with her 
trainee, achieving outstanding results in 
the Twinkle Series.

Amidst all this, the "Aoharu Cup" began, 
and the team tournament got underway.

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's it like to compete as a team?! We 
all get to train together, right!?

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, I haven't really had many friends 
until now... so I'm really looking forward 
to this!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I too look forward to seeing your 
growth.

However... The members who joined were 
below average in ability. The difference 
in skill between them and the Umamusume in 
my charge was clear.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Additional voluntary team training, you 
say? Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right now is the critical moment in the 
Twinkle Series! I know that full well.

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there is plenty I can teach 
them...”

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do, I want to do 
it! Please!

My trainee did everything she could for 
her teammates as they struggled to bridge 
the gap in their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...It seems fatigue is catching up with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Our target Classic graded race is coming 
up. How about taking a break from the next 
Aoharu Cup?

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if I don't run, our team's 
ranking might drop.

text_block_list.name: Trainee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Since I worked so hard to get my training 
level this high, I don't want it to drop. 
This is where I have to push through.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
... Understood. I will respect your 
wishes.

Pouring cold water on them now might 
destroy the unity they've built.

Acting Principal Kashimoto decided to 
believe in the Umamusume and the team she 
was in charge of.
However, one day—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A fall just ahead of the third corner! 
She's gone down! Is she all right!?
(Wee-woo, wee-woo, wee-woo...)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The cause is a breakdown in form due to a 
stress fracture. It seems you were pushing 
yourself far too hard.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
She can live a normal daily life, but 
running in races as a horse girl is no 
longer—

Due to this accident, their Umamusume was 
forced to retire. She ended up dropping 
out of Tracen Academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"If only I had kept a closer eye on 
her...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And thus, she came to fear the rampage of 
her emotions if left unchecked—!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She became firmly convinced that strict 
supervision is the only way to protect 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ……B-But!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto's managed training 
program was flawless, and it made us 
grow!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Her skill is undeniably second to 
none! She is truly indispensable to our 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I am currently 
searching! For a way to wake her up!"

The mystery of Acting Principal Kashimoto, 
the mystery of Chairwoman Akikawa's 
actions... Everything had been solved, but 
even more than that—

Faced with Acting Director Kashimoto's 
unimaginable past, everyone was left 
utterly speechless...
